title: Design System: WQ-USV 作业界面

currentCockpit.layout: USVFlyViewLayout.cockpitLayout; font-derived metrics; native map tool insets
currentCockpit.safety: Dual propulsion/payload stop; ACK is not actual stop; explicit telemetry and physical verification before unlocking; process-local Vehicle safety latch
currentCockpit.legacyScope: Existing workflow motion, breakpoints, nativeQml, component previews and narrative below describe the earlier preparation dock. Preserve as history; currentCockpit and the current DESIGN.md section govern the approved cockpit.

title.purpose: 采样准备区域、当前操作与危险确认标题；字号随 QGC 运行时字号缩放。

body.purpose: 说明、状态、步骤名称、诊断与确认正文。

label.purpose: 共用文字按钮与当前准备步骤的强调文字。

metric.purpose: 检测电压与吸光度；无有效测量显示破折号。

motion.name: workflow-height
motion.purpose: 展开／收起流程带的高度变化；收起即禁用正文并把焦点交还标题区展开按钮。

motion.name: workflow-content-opacity
motion.purpose: 正文随展开／收起淡入淡出。

motion.name: detail-reveal-wait
motion.purpose: 等待流程带高度稳定后再定位详情。

motion.name: detail-reveal-scroll
motion.purpose: 滚动至包含设备与诊断入口的详情区域，保留切换和收回入口。

nativeQml.paletteContext: 前置颜色为 QGCPalette 默认 enabled Dark 的输入。运行时主题、插件与平台仍由 QGC 管理；组件使用本地绑定派生颜色，不修改全局主题。
nativeQml.fontBinding: QGCLabel.font.family = ScreenTools.normalFontFamily; Chinese/default path uses Open Sans; Korean locale selects NanumGothic; missing glyph fallback is resolved by Qt/platform.

layoutBindings.dockInsets: Use native left/right side and bottom tool insets; lift above bottom controls only when besideWidth cannot fit the dock. Overlay already begins below the official toolbar.
layoutBindings.workflowColumns: stacked ? 1 : compact ? 2 : 3; primary action spans two columns only in the two-column layout.
layoutBindings.deviceControls: Flow wraps at available logical width.
layoutBindings.mapInsets: QGCToolInsets inherits native insets and contributes the dock to left/center bottom avoidance; native right-side instruments remain authoritative.

componentBindings.buttonEmergencyFill: flat destructive: Qt.tint(surface, Qt.rgba(danger.r, danger.g, danger.b, hovered ? 0.28 : 0.14))
componentBindings.collapsedVisibility: Title, readiness, alert, feedback, emergency and expand controls stay outside the disabled body.

nativeQml.nativeIntegration: custom/custom.qrc no longer overrides FlyViewToolBar or FlyViewBottomRightRowLayout; USVOptions.showInstrumentPanel returns true. The production surface reuses official top status/confirmation and overlay navigation instruments.
telemetryPresentation: Signal, baseline, sampling status, steps and loops come from Facts; invalid signal hides past voltage values; absorbance also requires a set baseline.
Pump X/Y/Z/A values are angles only; no running state is inferred from them.
Sending, ACK accepted and telemetry state update are distinct feedback stages; pending or awaited commands prevent duplicate start actions, while stop commands retain their allowed conditions.
Emergency stop opens the existing confirmation path; an accepted command is not proof of actual device stop.
nativeQml.previewTranslation: HTML/CSS snippets are self-contained static design-panel samples, not the product implementation. Literal colors resolve the enabled Dark palette and Qt QColor transforms. CSS ch/lh/mm approximate native metrics for this panel only; ScreenTools/QML bindings stay authoritative. Samples do not connect to a vehicle or execute commands.
nativeQml.tonalRampStatus: Eight-step OKLCH ramps are synthesized only for swatch inspection. They are not additional QML colors or production scales.
evidenceLimits: Qt offscreen evidence uses the production workflow QML with mock Facts; sample values and measurements are not device facts.
Screenshot top bars are explicitly marked validation placeholders; they do not define a custom product toolbar.
The map background is a schematic verification surface, not a production map design.
Official top bar and navigation instruments are restored from native resources; the design-panel snippets do not reproduce them.
Physical viewport sizes and simulated fontWidth values are QA inputs, not production breakpoints or pixel tokens.
nativeQml.deliberatelyNotCanonized: 验证占位顶栏、示意地图、mock 遥测、原型 hex 与模拟 fontWidth；它们属于预览或测试夹具，不是原生产品视觉与设备事实。

narrative.overview:
地图是驾驶与任务判断的工作底面。官方 QGC 顶栏和 overlay 航行仪表继续承担航行信息，新增工具表面使用实色深色、清晰中文和稳定的状态语义。信息紧凑，当前条件、有效测量与可执行动作有明确层级，服务于户外使用 Windows 笔记本的驾驶员和采样操作员。

本系统记录当前生产作业组件的视觉规则，不定义上游 QGC 的全部页面。视觉事实来自 `custom/res/USVOperationsTheme.qml`、`USVOperationsButton.qml`、`USVSamplingWorkflow.qml`、`USVFlyViewCustomLayer.qml` 和 `USVActionBar.qml` 的急停确认。颜色、字体与逻辑尺寸继续继承 QGC；原生顶栏及仪表的形态由上游资源负责。
keyCharacteristics: 不透明的工业深色表面，依靠明度与细边界分层。
蓝色操作与选中状态，绿色就绪，橙色警示，红色故障与急停。
当前步骤、测量数值、常规状态文字和次要标签组成可扫读的层级。
尺寸随 QGC 字体度量与可用逻辑空间变化。
操作提示区分发送、设备接受和遥测确认的实际状态。

rules.name: The 状态语义 Rule
rules.body: 蓝色指向操作、当前步骤与选中入口，绿色指向已满足条件，橙色指向等待与警示，红色指向故障与急停；颜色始终配合可读状态文字。

rules.name: The 度量一致 Rule
rules.body: 字体继承 `ScreenTools.normalFontFamily`，字号与空间继承运行时 QGC 字体度量；预览夹具的字体、点数和像素尺寸不作为产品常量。

rules.name: The 实色分层 Rule
rules.body: 新增作业工具表面和危险确认面使用实色底面；通过明度与必要边界分层，使地图内容不影响文字与控制的阅读。

dos: **Do** 复用 `USVOperationsTheme.qml` 和 `USVOperationsButton.qml`，让作业组件共享颜色、尺寸和交互状态。
**Do** 让状态颜色与明确文字共同出现，并保留未知、离线、等待和故障的区别。
**Do** 按运行时字体度量安排间距、圆角和控件高度，按可用逻辑宽度适配。
**Do** 为长告警、操作反馈和确认正文保留换行空间，为诊断内容保留滚动通道。
**Do** 使用可见的键盘焦点，并以设备条件控制按钮启用状态。
**Do** 分开表达命令发送、设备接受与遥测确认的实际作业状态。
**Do** 保留官方顶栏、航行仪表及任务确认交互，让新工具表面遵守原生 inset。
**Do** 让详情入口、收起状态和急停入口在字体放大及内容滚动后仍可达。
donts: **Don't** 用预览夹具的字体、数值或固定像素尺寸替代 QGC 的运行时来源。
**Don't** 让未知或离线数据看起来像有效的零值，或让命令接受看起来像设备已经完成动作。
**Don't** 把航线进度与采样完成状态混为同一个指标。
**Don't** 从泵组角度推断或伪造泵的运行状态。
**Don't** 将本次作业界面的构图、演示地图标注或验证视口推广成全部上游 QGC 的视觉规则。
